intro: The Tome of Divinity is a foundational holy trial requiring initiates of the Light to seek out and assist a citizen of pure heart and noble motive in Stormwind. Directing champions to Stephanie Turner in the Trade District, the task emphasizes that true service begins with humble charity toward the vulnerable.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your task then, friend, is to find someone here in Stormwind that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.
Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, hello, luv. How go your adventures? Oh, I'm so glad to hear you're doing well.
Oh, me? Thank you for asking--I'm doing well, all things considered.

The increase in tradesmen has kind of put a damper on the amount of leather and cloth people are willing to part with these days, so it's been tougher to make clothing for the children at the orphanage, but we'll manage. By "we" I mean my husband and I. He's up in Ironforge trying to seek help from the citizens there.
